scope: Finite downstream scheduler of normalized artificial accepted-material events; no input acquisition or upstream commit verification
lexicalSelection: Latest matching ending offset in bounded recent material window; longer match breaks a same-end tie; sphere/box/ring order breaks a remaining tie. English ASCII word boundaries, case insensitive; Japanese literal substring. Quotes and negation are not interpreted.
perWordSegmentation: Intl.Segmenter ja word granularity; one lexical-analysis call per isWordLike incoming segment, using its incoming prefix and prior bounded window; no lookahead to later words in the same material batch
batchWork: Analyze dirty bounded window at fixed 2000 ms points only. Idle does not repeatedly re-analyze an unchanged window.
hysteresis: At least 2 consecutive timed matching observations plus 5000 ms since last actual shape change. Second observation can use the cached unchanged query result; it is temporal consistency, not independent semantic evidence. Cached sampling never refreshes evidence time/expiry. Changed window is analyzed anew.
candidateExpiry: Evidence keyword's material timestamp + 6000 ms; expire before apply at equality. No stale candidate may be applied after focus/gap/hide/pause reset.
material: Known normalized material appends logical body immediately after whole-event admission within capacity. Per-insertion grapheme units preserve unnormalized original sequence, fresh monotonic ID and batch ink. No shape analysis can delay admission.
presentation: Independent artificial reveal cursor advances at most 4 units per 100 ms visible nonpaused tick; no duplicated text queue. Hidden/paused body admission remains finite and immediate, presentation cursor stops.
hidePauseResume: No analysis, cached sampling, shape application or reveal while hidden/paused. Reset candidate/cache, retain bounded recent material. After both gates reopen, all policies schedule one bounded catchup at now+2000 ms; do not replay hidden words. Reveal resumes at now+100 ms in small steps.
focusGap: Focus changes clear candidate/cache/recent window, keep append history/current shape/minimum-hold history. Global normalized seq gaps are disclosed, clear lexical context, and cannot reconstruct missing material. Stale epoch material is explicitly rejected.
overflow: Whole event capacity hold without truncation; record rejected units. This downstream hold does not establish an upstream no-loss guarantee or implement a no-ACK replay adapter.
rawSavingOff: Default true: bounded body/recent text are volatile; export is whitelist metadata/IDs/colors/counts/shape/times only, no body/query/window text or text fingerprint. Explicit false may export bounded committed body text only. Synthetic fixture text remains a separate reproducibility artifact.
interpretation: Mechanism comparison only, not classifier accuracy, command understanding, natural-language meaning, comfort or constant-app resource achievement. Any post-result parameter/code change requires R2 regression labeling.
